title: ONE SOUND SETTING FOR THE PAIR: BOTH, PLAYER 1 ONLY OR PLAYER 2 ONLY
why: His order of 2026-10-02. Each window had its own SOUND ON/OFF button and read what the other window had said. Now one setting, in the PARTY window, says where world sound plays: both players, player 1 only or player 2 only, and both windows follow it the moment it changes. With both, SPLIT SPEAKERS still puts player 1 left and player 2 right.
now: Two-player sound is one setting in the PARTY window: WORLD SOUND: BOTH PLAYERS, PLAYER 1 ONLY or PLAYER 2 ONLY. Both windows follow it.
